g.text: - Wait/poll improves UX but increases p99 risk
Hard case — timeout after commit / crash window
- Process crashes before Complete(record) => record stuck in Started
- Minimize window (complete idempotency right after commit)
- Cap "Started" age and return 202/409 for reconciliation
- Optionally reconcile by reading domain state (only if deterministic identity exists)
- Response snapshot OR pointer strategy (PII/storage trade-off)
